items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And I bought the -- who was it that sang with Bing when they made a record, 'Count Your Blessings'? Andrews Sisters.

ctx.x: I was listening to other people's songs, like I'd listen to -- let me see, who was I crazy about? Bing Crosby. I bought his first ten cent record. I bought his record. And I bought the -- who was it that sang with Bing when they made a record, 'Count Your Blessings'? Andrews Sisters.
